entry.name: ddg.mono
entry.digest: Monophonic Synth Controller for Virtual Synths
entry.description: ddg.mono provides MIDI message handling for virtual monophonic synths in Max. It implements last/high/low note priority and legato/retrigger phrasing.

arguments.name: note priority
arguments.description: An optional integer argument in the range 0 - 2 can be used to specify note priority. The mode settings are:mode 0 (retrigger): Retrigger on each keypress (default).mode 1 (legato): When a note is held, new notes ignore velocity.mode 2 (laststep): Send a noteoff message on last note only.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Themessage will send a note-off message to stop any notes which are currently playing.

messages.name: in1
messages.digest: Store as a velocity to pair with pitch values
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as a velocity to be paired with pitch numbers received in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In first inlet: The number is treated as a pitch value for a MIDI note-on message. Output of the received number and its corresponding velocity value is dependent on theattribute and the triggering modes (set using theormessages).In second inlet: The number is stored as a velocity to be paired with pitch numbers received in the left inlet.

messages.name: laststep
messages.digest: Send a note-off for the last note played
messages.description: Themessage will cause theobject to send a note-off message for the last note played.

messages.name: legato
messages.digest: Send output only when a new note is played
messages.description: Themessage will cause theobject to send its output only when a new note is played.

messages.name: retrig
messages.digest: Send output on each key press (retrigger)
messages.description: Themessage will cause theobject to send its output on each key press (i.e., retriggering previously played notes).
